title: StockSmart Vending Operations Note — Machine Return Rate and the Return Share on Opening Consigned Stock
content:
**Applies to:** opening consigned stock of a new StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines.

**Rule.** Units of the transferred item returned to the demand machine in the last three months, divided by the units vended there in those months, put a return share into the carried share: 0.1 or more puts 0.75, 0.05 or more but below 0.1 puts 0.9, and less, or no vends in those months, puts no return share in.

The demand machine is the machine of the customer's most recent VendPoint selection removal of the item made at the customer's request. Returns and vends at other machines are not counted. The last three months hold rows of age below three, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month. The units vended are the units issued, before any return or vend error credit.

| Returned units divided by vended units | Return share |
|---|---|
| 0.1 or more | 0.75 |
| 0.05 or more, below 0.1 | 0.9 |
| below 0.05 | none put in |
| no vends in the window | none put in |

**Hypothetical machine.** 200 units vended and 20 returned: 0.1, so 0.75. 200 vended and 10 returned: 0.05, so 0.9. 200 vended and 9 returned: 0.045, none.
